text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Grass Wonder! Grass Wonder<n>has won the
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That's the Beast's successor for<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Even Maruzensky couldn't make this<n>dream a
reality!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder says nothing as the<n>acclaim
continues pouring in. She<n>keeps her head bowed
respectfully<n>low.
During lunch a few days later...

Trainer, may I have a moment before<n>we begin
today's training session?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have a gift for you. It's... nothing all<n>too special.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Just a small token of my appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I didn't achieve the Triple Crown all<n>on my own.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm merely the one who's subject to<n>the public's
eye.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I feel that the message should<n>come directly
from myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We won the Triple Crown. ♪ Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, she presents three small<n>winner's
sashes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown is the highest honor<n>one can
achieve in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A dream the vast majority of<n>Umamusume will
never realize, no<n>matter how badly they may want
it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I feel that I can truly stand tall.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for making me a Triple<n>Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No... I still have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder seems to be implying<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If I may add something minor as<n>well...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The defeated Umamusume aren't the<n>only ones
who couldn't realize their<n>Triple Crown dreams.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Many never get the chance to<n>compete at all, due to
various<n>circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The wall of "if only" that many<n>Umamusume run into
is unfathomably<n>high.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, now that I've received<n>the highest of
honors...

I fully comprehend the enormity of the<n>wall I must
clear.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That's why I'll fasten my helm<n>on tight and
strive to be even better<n>moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My determination holds strong. I hope<n>that yours
won't falter either.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I glimpse a burning blue flame within<n>her eyes
before it disappears behind<n>her serene smile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep... Completely ignored once again.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh? Whatcha doing over here, Sei?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nothing really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, wanna hit up the<n>shopping district?
Maybe get some<n>taiyaki, sweets, or something?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds nice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But also kind of sudden...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Meh... I need a distraction, and I figure<n>food'll do
the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the Classic Triple<n>Crown ends on a
quiet note. The<n>Japan Cup, however, is right around
the corner.
